answer:
Based on my research, Jimmy Carter was nominated for president at **Madison Square Garden** in New York City during the 1976 Democratic National Convention.

Madison Square Garden is the home arena for the **New York Knicks**, which is the only NBA team based in New York City. 

Therefore, any other New York City team would **not** host NBA games at Madison Square Garden, since:
1. MSG is exclusively the home of the New York Knicks for NBA games
2. No other NBA franchises exist in New York City
3. Other NYC professional teams play different sports (basketball being unique to the Knicks in NYC)

For example, teams like the **New York Yankees** (MLB), **New York Rangers** (NHL), **New York Jets/Giants** (NFL), or **New York Mets** (MLB) do not host NBA games at Madison Square Garden or anywhere else in NYC because they compete in different leagues and sports entirely.
